newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran says Iraq-based rebels kill one near border.
newsitem.headline: Iran says Iraq-based rebels kill one near border.

text.p: Iran said on Friday rebels based in neighbouring Iraq killed one person in a cross-border attack in western Iran.

A local official in the Iranian border town of Qasr-e Shirin said members of the Mujahideen Khalq group carried out the attack in the area on Wednesday, killing a border tribesman, Iran's official news agency IRNA reported.
"The attackers escaped to Iraq leaving behind a Kalashnikov (assault rifle) and a sidearm," the official said. The report was monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC).

Tehran has blamed the armed opposition group for several cross-border attacks and bombings in the past few years. The Mujahideen have denied attacking civilians, but have taken responsibility for hitting military and economic targets.
